name: B10-0468/2026 – § 101 – Am 1
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 2026 UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya, Türkiye (COP31)
part_text: 101. Stresses that cutting methane emissions from oil and gas operations is one of the fastest, most cost-effective and immediately available ways to reduce GHG emissions; reiterates the importance of reducing methane emissions in the fossil fuel supply chains globally during the transition to clean energy systems, in order to reach a global reduction of 75 % of methane emissions by 2030 as set out in the Net-Zero Emissions by 2050 Scenario of the International Energy Agency(IEA); recalls that Regulation(EU) 2024/1787 on the reduction of methane emissions in the energy sector boosts transparency on methaneemission imports and fair competition withnon-EU countries stresses, however, thatimplementation challenges need to be urgently addressed to ensure its effective application.;
